verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation feature, such as a workflow builder, scheduled agent or trigger-action rules, that runs autonomously in the background. Fellow's automatic meeting summaries are fixed built-in behavior, not automations the user sets up. The webhooks and REST API are developer building blocks a developer could use to build their own automations, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
